Q: wget: bad address 'github.com' A:

My ISP doesn't support IPv6. I enabled dns port in tor and docker used it for its dns queries, which leaded to OP wget error in alpine containers, but not in debian ones. Host's nslookup returned NXDOMAIN error for IPv6 addresses and IPv4 were fine. On host I installed dnsmasq and configured it to query tor's dns, and "tuned" docker to dnsmasq for all new containers. Nslookup still errors IPv6 but alpine error has gone.

Q: ORA-19202: Error occurred in XML processing LPX-00210: expected '<' instead of 'M' Error at line 1 A:

I have faced the same issue and I was able to solve that by correcting the Xpath within the extractvalue() function. I have entered a wrong Xpath for the CLOB value extraction. Hope this might be help full to solve your problem.

Q: Two Rust crates each bundle their own libcrypto (OpenSSL + BoringSSL) and fight over the same symbols — what's the right way to deal with this? A:

webrtc-sys is a wrapper around Google's webrtc which depends heavily on bundled BoringSSL, unbundling it involves rebuilding from source while modifying Google's build scripts. So this is not a viable option.

One option is to ship a single SSL implementation, which is by necessity is BoringSSL bundled to webrtc, which you are already doing.

The other option is to ship two SSL implementations and un-conflict them. If you are building a static executable, the only way to do that seems to be to rename (not localize) symbols with objcopy --redefine-syms as part of your your build process.

If you are building at least one shared library/DLL, the other option is to make conflicting symbols not exported from that library.

Q: pyright fails parsing TypeForm for Unions with embedded containers A:

This is a Pyright-specific bug and is reducible to the type checker not making UnionType assignable to TypeForm in general. The following example type checks under mypy, ty, Zuban, and Pyrefly, but not Pyright:

from typing_extensions import TypeForm

unparameterized: TypeForm = object | None
parameterized: TypeForm[object] = object | None

I've opened a bug report on the Pyright repo.
